fields.en: source text from the inventory, unchanged
fields.ru: the translation; placeholders, HTML, LaTeX and key names kept
fields.plural: Intl.PluralRules("ru") forms one/few/many/other when the sentence has a count (other = fractional numbers)
fields.ru_short: shorter variant for a label that risks overflowing
fields.split: the English string glues a word in a slot; Russian needs one key per value of that slot (each value may itself hold plural forms)
fields.keep: true when the text is not visible (CSS, ids, font stacks) or must not change (brand, key names, formula examples)
fields.missing_from_inventory: true for .extra. keys; their en is the code template as written in the source (with ${...} shown as {...}), not an inventory text
fields.en_key: the English template the phase-2 call site writes when it differs from en: identifier names, %{name} in a template with TeX (review i18n-4). It renders exactly en. The table key is en_key.
fields.ph: for a renamed slot, what it stands for in en ("{2}", or a literal such as "," that English always fills in)
fields.en_plural: [one, many]: the English pair of a plural entry ($tn key one + U+0004 + many); per split variant when the entry splits (review i18n-5). The count is {n}.
fields.ctx: a $tx/$tn context, when two entries share one English text
